source: 804 Consultation
target: 804 Consultatio

source: “He might not use that name in Morora.
target: “Fortasse illum nomen in Morora non utetur.

source: I knew him before and saw him again yesterday when he came to the bar to duel with the owner.
target: Eum antea noveram et heri iterum vidi, cum ad tabernam venit ut cum domino certaret.

source: He has red hair.
target: Crines rubros habet.

source: In Morora, anyone with red hair, no matter the shade, is trouble…”
target: In Morora, quicumque crines rubros gerit, cuiuscumque umbrae sit, periculum est…

source: Lumian described Albus Medici’s appearance in detail.
target: Lumian Albus Medici aspectum minutatim descripsit.

source: Chef Lez nodded.
target: Chef Lez annuit.

source: “I’ll keep that in mind.”
target: “Id in mente tenebo.”

source: “Are you sure? Do you need me to sketch them for you?” Lumian asked earnestly.
target: “Esne certus? Num tibi opus est ut ea delineem?” Lumian sincere quaesivit.

source: He wasn’t just asking Lez but also Julie, who was coming down the stairs slowly.
target: Non solum Lez quaerebat, sed etiam Iuliam, quae lente scala descendebat.

source: He wanted to give the Demoness something to focus on, hoping she’d be aware of Wanak and Albus Medici soon enough, letting trouble collide with trouble to see who was the bigger problem.
target: Volebat daemonissae aliquid ad quo intendere posset, sperans ut mox de Wanak et Albus Medici notam haberet, et sinens difficultates inter se concurrere ut videatur quae maior incommoditas esset.

source: Lez shook his head slowly.
target: Lez caput leniter movit.

source: “No need. I’ll remember them like different ingredients with distinct features.”
target: “Nulla necessitas. Ea meminero tamquam diversos ingredientes cum proprietatibus distinctis.”

source: “Different ingredients, like a turkey?” Lumian imagined Albus Medici looking like a turkey and laughed.
target: “Diversi ingredientes, ut meleagris?” Lumian imaginatus est Albus Medici quasi meleagris aspectum habere et risit.

source: He then handed Lez 200 sassen gold coins to restock the bar with meat and drinks.
target: Deinde Lez tradidit ducentos nummos aureos Sassen ut taberna carnium et potuum reficeretur.

source: As he turned to leave the kitchen, he saw Julie reaching the bottom of the stairs.
target: Dum se ex coquina discedere vertit, Iuliam vidit ad imum gradum scalae pervenire.

source: The Demoness had changed into fresh, clean clothes—an elegant white blouse paired with an ankle‐length green skirt, highlighting her gentle and graceful demeanor.
target: Daemonissa se mutavit in vestimenta recens et pura – elegans tunica alba cum lorā viridā (qui usque ad talōs descendit) quae indolem eius mitissimam atque eleganter habitam ostendit.

source: Lumian suddenly recalled the sounds he heard last night, which contrasted sharply with Julie’s current serene appearance.
target: Lumian subito meminit sonitus, quos nocte priore audiverat, qui acerrime contrarii erant cum sereno vultu Iuliae.

source: His mouth went dry.
target: Os eius aridum factum est.

source: Dammit, this Demoness is subtly using Charm on me!
target: Heu, haec daemonissa subdole mihi incantamentum imponit!

source: It was normal to react, but this strong reaction wasn’t right for an Ascetic like Lumian.
target: Reagere normale erat, sed talis vehementia ascetae ut Lumian non convenit.

source: He looked at Julie and raised an eyebrow.
target: Iuliam aspexit et supercilium levavit.

source: “Do you remember the second rule of the bar?”
target: “Meministine secundam regulam tabernae?”

source: Julie, looking more radiant than yesterday, seemed to glow with inner joy.
target: Iulia, splendentius quam heri, ex interiore gaudio lucebat.

source: Lumian felt an urge to rub his forehead.
target: Lumian desideravit frontem terere.

source: Hey gal, are you really not worried about exposing that Celeste visited you last night?
target: Heus, puella, nonne cures ut patefatur quod Celeste te heri nocte visitaverit?

source: Although you don’t know that I witnessed you sprinting to Celeste yesterday and suffered a huge blow…
target: Quamquam nescis me te heri ad Celeste currere conspectum esse et ingentem ictum passi esse…

source: Julie smiled gently.
target: Iulia leniter subridit.

source: “Don’t harass the boss.”
target: “Noli vexare praefectum.”

source: “You were Charming me just now,” Lumian stated flatly.
target: “Modo me incantavisti,” Lumian aequabiliter dixit.

source: Julie shrank back, feigning fear.
target: Iulia recedebat, simulans timorem.

source: “What… what are you going to do to punish me?”
target: “Quid… quid facies ut me punias?”

source: She acted scared but her eyes sparkled with amusement, as if she was teasing Lumian.
target: Ea se timidum praestitit, sed oculi eius cum ioco micabant, quasi Lumian deriderent.

source: Lumian sighed, half‐genuine, half‐deliberate.
target: Lumian suspiravit, dimidio sincere, dimidio deliberato.

source: “First-time offense can be forgiven. But don’t let it happen again, or else…”
target: “Prima culpa ignoscitur. Sed ne id iterum fiat, alioquin…”

source: He didn’t finish the sentence, leaving an ominous silence.
target: Non confecit sententiam, relinquens silentium ominosum.

source: “Yes, boss!” Julie beamed.
target: “Ita, domine!”

source: She glanced at the door.
target: Ianuam aspexit.

source: “The bar won’t open until noon. Can I go out for a bit?”
target: “Taberna non aperietur usque ad meridiem. Possumne paululum exire?”

source: “Sure,” Lumian teased. “Planning to add to your collection? Do you have a morning exercise routine?”
target: “Certe,” Lumian iocose dixit. “Cogitasne addere ad collectionem tuam? Habesne exercitatio matutina?”

source: “No,” Julie shook her head lightly. “Just want to explore the city more.”
target: “Non,” Iulia caput leve concussit. “Modo urbem amplius explorare volo.”

source: As she left the bar, Lumian immediately teleported ahead, transforming into a shadow creature to follow her.
target: Dum ea tabernam relinquit, Lumian statim se in creaturam umbratam transformavit ut eam sequeretur.

source: But Julie vanished.
target: Sed Iulia evanuit.

source: Invisibility, then wiped her tracks, and did anti-divination?
target: Invisibilitas, deinde vestigia sua delevit, atque contra divinationem processit?

source: Lumian emerged from the shadows, frowning slightly.
target: Lumian ex umbris emersit, leviter frontem contrahens.

source: This meant what Julie was doing this morning was very important.
target: Hoc significabat quod id, quod Iulia hac mane faciebat, valde grave erat.

source: She didn’t want anyone to know!
target: Noluit ut quisquam id sciret!

source: Also, having finally met her lover and found solace, she was more professional now, unlike her near‑breakdown last night.
target: Etiam, postquam tandem amatum suum convenit et solacium invenit, nunc professionalior se gerebat, contra cladem paene heri nocte.

source: This was the normal behavior of a Sequence 5 Demoness of Affliction.
target: Hoc erat habitus normalis daemonissae afflictionis, Sequenciae V.

source: Lumian wasn’t too disappointed.
target: Lumian non erat nimis deiectus.

source: At least Julie now knew about Wanak and Albus Medici.
target: Saltem nunc Iulia de Wanak et Albus Medici sciebat.

source: Following the nearest path, he walked towards the cemetery but didn’t dig any graves or sneak underground.
target: Viā proximam sequens, ad coemeterium ambulavit, sed nec sepulcra effodit nec sub terram furtim accessit.

source: Instead, he went straight into the library‑like Knowledge Cathedral.
target: Proinde directo ingressus est in cathedralem Scientiae, bibliothecam similem.

source: Today, he was not merely tracking Julie.
target: Hodie non tantum Iuliam sequeretur.

source: His main goal was to visit Archbishop Heraberg of Morora.
target: Summum propositum eius erat Archiepiscopum Heraberg de Morora visitare.

source: The title of Morora’s Archbishop was Lumian’s creation.
target: Titulus Archiepiscopi Mororae a Lumiano creatus erat.

source: After all, this puppet‑like clergy member of the Church of Knowledge claimed to oversee all theological affairs in Morora.
target: Nam hic membrum clericii, quasi marionetta Ecclesiae Scientiae, asserebat omnia negotia theologica in Morora sub sua potestate esse.

source: Lumian felt that since the Church of Knowledge had ‘recommended’ him into Morora without confiscating his mystical items, direct inquiry about the underground mausoleum might be surprisingly effective rather than probing indirectly.
target: Lumian sensit quod, cum Ecclesia Scientiae eum in Morora sine confiscandis rebus mysticis “commendaverit”, directa inquisitio de mausoleo subterraneo prorsus miro modo efficax foret potius quam indirecta indagatio.

source: This was also a test.
target: Hoc etiam probatio erat.

source: Lumian wanted to see if the sealing information about 0‑01 was given only to him or distributed to all eligible individuals.
target: Lumian videre cupiebat utrum notitia de sigillo circa 0‑01 soli ei data esset an omnibus idoneis distributa.

source: Did the Church of Knowledge place its bet solely on him, or did it hedge its bets across multiple candidates?
target: Num Ecclesia Scientiae tantum in eum sors posuerit, an in pluribus candidatis fidem deposuerit?

source: Inside the radiant holy cathedral, Lumian found Heraberg, with his graying hair, kind eyes, and white robe with brass embroidery, standing by a brass bookshelf, quietly reading a thick book.
target: Intra splendidam cathedralem sanctam, Lumian Heraberg invenit, cum capillis canitie factis, oculis benignis, et toga alba cum ornamentis aereis, stantem iuxta armariam auream, librum crassum tacite legens.

source: “Archbishop,” Lumian called tentatively.
target: “Archiepiscopus,” Lumian dubitanter vocavit.

source: Heraberg looked up and asked warmly, “What puzzles you?”
target: Heraberg sursum aspexit et benigne quaesivit: “Quid te perplexum facit?”

source: Lumian chose his words carefully.
target: Lumian verba sua caute elegit.

source: “If I want to enter the cemetery’s underground section to find something, how can I avoid the dangers?”
target: “Si in subterraneam coemeterii partem ingredi voluerim ad aliquid invenire, quomodo pericula vitare possim?”

source: Heraberg smiled and pointed to the brass bookshelf beside him.
target: Heraberg subridens ad armariam auream iuxta se stantem digitum extulit.

source: “This one, this one, and this one… read them all thoroughly.”
target: “Hunc, hunc, et hunc… omnes diligenter lege.”

source: Lumian followed his gesture, mentally noting the book titles:
target: Lumian signum eius secutus, titulos librorum mente notans:

source: “Morora Residents’ Code,”
target: “Codex Incolarum Mororae,”

source: “Doll Crafting and Maintenance,”
target: “Ars Pupae conficiendae et conservandae,”

source: “Examples of Mausoleum Construction,”
target: “Exempla Aedificii Mausolei,”

source: “Principles of Sealing”…
target: “Principia Sigillandi”…

source: What use is this for a Hunter like me?
target: “Quid hoc prodest venatori sicut ego?”

source: I’m not a Reader who can wield knowledge directly.
target: “Non sum lector qui scientiam directe adhibere possit.”

source: Does this mean that by absorbing the knowledge in these books, I can grasp the layout of the underground mausoleum, understand the sealing mechanisms, and find a way to leave my mark on 0‑01?
target: “Significatne hoc quod, scientiam his libris absorptam, possim dispositionem mausolei subterranei comprehendere, mechanismos sigillandi intellegere, atque viam invenire ut vestigium meum in 0‑01 relinquam?”

source: Lumian thought deeply as he withdrew his gaze.
target: Lumian profunde cogitavit dum oculos avertit.

source: Heraberg continued, “Once you’ve read those, complete these test papers. You must score perfectly on each one.”
target: Heraberg perrexit: “Postquam illa legisti, has chartas probationis confice; in quaelibet nota perfecte assequenda est.”

source: Lumian looked at the stack of test papers filling a shelf.
target: Lumian aspexit super catervam chartarum probationis quae armariam implebant.

source: His forehead twitched, recalling some unpleasant memories.
target: Frons eius convulsus est, non jucundas memorias revocans.

source: He maintained a neutral expression, confirming, “So, once I finish reading and acing these tests, I can avoid the underground dangers?”
target: Vultum neutrum retinuit, dicens: “Ita ergo, postquam has chartas legero atque expediam, pericula subterranea vitare possum?”

source: Heraberg pointed to another brass bookshelf.
target: Heraberg ad aliam armariam auream digitum extulit.

source: “That one, that one, and that one. Master all the knowledge on those shelves, and you’ll be well‑prepared.”
target: “Illam, illam, et illam. Omnem scientiam in istis armariis percipe, et bene praeparatus eris.”

source: Three shelves? Lumian’s lips twitched slightly.
target: “Tres armaria? Labra Luminiani leviter contrectabantur.”

source: That’s about two or three hundred books, plus thousands of test papers, right?
target: “Id est circiter ducenti aut trecenti libri, praeterea milia chartarum probationis, nonne?”

source: Heraberg smiled and sighed.
target: Heraberg subridens suspiravit.

source: “Remember, knowledge equals power, and knowledge equals wealth. All the answers you seek lie within.”
target: “Memento, scientia potentia est, et scientia divitia est; omnia responsa quae quaeris intus iacent.”

source: Lumian’s expression shifted as he bit his lip and said, “I’ll start with these.”
target: Vultus Luminiani mutatus est dum labium mordebat, et dixit: “His incipiam.”

source: He pulled out the initial books Heraberg pointed out.
target: Extraxit libros initios quos Heraberg indicaverat.

source: Heraberg nodded approvingly.
target: Heraberg annuit approbans.

source: “A Hunter who learns and pursues knowledge is the most powerful Hunter.
target: “Venator qui discit et scientiam persequitur, potentissimus venator est.

source: “It’s been years since another Hunter came to me, willing to patiently read the designated books.
target: “Multos annos praeterierunt ex quo alius venator ad me venit, paratus designatos libros paciente legere.

source: The others, with red or thick hair, won’t even step into the Holy Temple of Knowledge, let alone approach these bookshelves.”
target: “Ceteri, cum crinibus rubris aut densis, ne in Templum Sanctum Scientiae quidem intrabunt, quanto minus ad has armarias appropinquare.”

source: It’s because Aurore instilled a reading habit in me from a young age…
target: “Nam Aurore in me consuetudinem legendi a tenera aetate intulit…”

source: Lumian thought, feeling a pang of sadness.
target: Lumian cogitavit, tristitiae acerrimam sentiens.

source: He placed the books into his Traveler’s Bag, bid farewell to Heraberg, and walked towards the Knowledge Cathedral’s entrance.
target: Libros in sacco Viatoris posuit, Heraberg valedixit, et ad ingressum Cathedralis Scientiae ambulavit.

source: Along the way, he saw a familiar figure—Guei, who had been exiled to Morora with him.
target: In via, vidit figuram familiaris—Guei, qui cum eo in Morora exsulatus erat.

source: The scholarly‑looking Guei, now dressed in thick, cotton clothing, stood by a brass bookshelf, engrossed in a book by the light of the stained glass window.
target: Guei, erudito speciei, nunc in vestibus spessis ex contextu indutus, stetit iuxta armariam auream, in libro luce fenestrae vitreae absorptus.

source: After a few seconds, Lumian walked over, smiling.
target: Post paucos secundos, Lumian accessit, subridente.

source: “What a coincidence. Why are you here reading?”
target: “Quale casus! Cur hic legis?”

source: Guei smiled faintly.
target: Guei leviter subridit.

source: “Didn’t I tell you yesterday? I regret not knowing enough. Now, with such a vast library, how could I pass up the chance to learn? What brings you here?”
target: “Nonne heri tibi dixi? Paenitet me quod satis non scivi. Nunc, cum tam vasta bibliotheca sit, quomodo occasionem discendi praetermitterem? Quid te hic adducit?”

source: “To ask if it’s too late to convert to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom,” Lumian joked, then changed the topic.
target: “Ad quaestionem: num sero sit ad Deum Scientiae et Sapientiae converti,” iocavit Lumian, deinde argumentum mutavit.

source: “Have you found a job yet?”
target: “Num iam munus invenisti?”

source: “Not yet,” Guei shook his head lightly.
target: “Nondum,” Guei caput leviter concussit.

source: “I don’t want to work on a farm or in a factory as some exile’s slave.
target: “Nolo in agro aut in fabrica laborare ut servus cuiusdam exsulis;

source: I’m planning to study for a while.
target: intendo aliquantulum studere.

source: Fortunately, I had some luck yesterday and earned some money, so I don’t have to worry about going hungry.”
target: Fortunate, heri quidam fortuna mihi adfuit et pecuniam lucratus sum, itaque de fames non sollicitus sum.

source: Lumian chatted with Guei for a bit before waving goodbye to the secretive serial killer and returning to the Carnivore bar.
target: Lumian cum Guei paulo sermocinatus est, antequam occulto interfectori seriali vale dixit et ad tabernam Carnivorum rediit.

source: He found a spot by the window and began reading the borrowed books in a comfortable position.
target: Invenit locum iuxta fenestram et libros mutuatos in loco commodo legere coepit.

source: Morora’s sunlight alternated between bright and hidden by storm clouds, but it didn’t affect Lumian’s reading as he had his radiant fireball lamp.
target: Sol Mororae inter claritatem atque nubibus tempestatis absconditum alterbat, sed lectio Luminiani non immutabatur, cum lampadem ignis radiante haberet.

source: Near noon, Julie returned, her steps light, her face smiling, exuding a charm that even made Chef Lez steal a few glances at her.
target: Prope meridiem, Iulia rediit, gradibus levis, facie subridente, venustatem effundens, quae etiam Chef Lez paucos intuitus ab ea subripuit.

source: Julie gave Lumian a curious look.
target: Iulia Luminiano aspectum curiosum dedit.

source: “You’re reading?”
target: “Legis?”

source: “Not much else to do,” Lumian replied casually.
target: “Non multum aliud,” Lumian respondit leve.

source: Julie had no interest in the books; she withdrew her gaze and went upstairs, likely looking for waitress attire.
target: Iulia de libris nihil curabat; oculos avertit et sursum ascendit, verisimiliter vestimenta ministrarum quaerens.

source: Lumian clicked his tongue silently.
target: Lumian linguam leviter frotavit tacite.

source: Really, knowledge is power, and knowledge is wealth.
target: Revera, scientia potentia est, et scientia divitia est.

source: Aren’t you curious about what I’m reading?
target: Nonne curiosa es quid legam?

source: Lez approached and said, “Boss, lunch is ready.”
target: Lez accessit et dixit: “Domine, prandium paratum est.”

source: Lumian nodded, put away the books, and stood up.
target: Lumian annuit, libros recondidit, et surrexit.

source: He thought for a moment and said to Lez, “Find a red cloth and hang it at the door.”
target: Paulisper meditatus est et Lez dixit: “Inveni pannum rubrum et ad ostium appende.”
